Featuring our Ainsley collar, Signature 6-Pleat Shirring® and barrel cuffs, for comfortable polish you won't find anywhere else. Technically superior, perfected over decades: our non-iron shirts keep you polished and virtually wrinkle-free all day, every day.

Available in Fits:
REGULAR is our standard, best-selling fit, designed for a wide range of body types.
SLIM is our most tailored, streamlined fit, cut closer to the body with a higher armhole.
Ainsley Collar
Barrel Cuff
  • 96% Cotton, 4% Spandex
  • Machine Wash according to care instructions for best results
  • Imported


We use American-grown Supima® cotton for its extra-long staple fibers that provide superior strength, softness, color retention, and longevity to our styles.
